notes.title: Painting mechanic and bug fixes
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello, Builders![/h1]
In this update, we've fixed several bugs, improved some systems, and added a new mechanic!

[h2]Fixed Bugs:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the character's hands would disappear in certain poses.
[*] Fixed a bug where tools could be grabbed from a distance.
[/list]
[h2]Сhanged mechanics:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Reworked the inventory system.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45075098/ab8f7501cd0b417b13aa7c4292179d918a63d88b.jpg[/img]
[*] Trees now yield more logs.
[*] Reworked a system that caused the chainsaw to deal inconsistent and unreliable damage to wood.
[/list]
[h2]New mechanic[/h2]
[list]
[*]You can now paint your buildings!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45075098/76f45eae9306611339b472f9c6bfcfb98b5c21c1.jpg[/img]
[/list]
[h2]We hope these changes bring some enjoyable variety to your building experience. Good luck out there - and stay safe on the construction site![/h2]

notes.title: Announcement of big changes in the game!
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello, Builders![/h1]
Initially, we planned to update the main game’s Steam page with new screenshots and visual improvements.
However, our plans have changed — all our efforts are now focused on preparing the demo version for participation in the [b]Steam Next Fest.[/b]

[h1]What does this mean for you?[/h1]
We're working on a major update to the demo, which will be released within a month. This is not just a patch — it’s a brand-new stage in the game’s development! Here's what to expect:
[list]
[*] [b]New content and materials[/b]
[*] [b]New tools[/b]
[*] [b]A fully-featured player body[/b]
[*] [b]A full physical character: running, jumping, crouching, grabbing objects[/b]
[*] [b]Updated forest visuals[/b]
[*] [b]A couple of new crafting options to enrich the gameplay[/b]
[/list]
[h3]Here are some screenshots of the new tools ↓[/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45075098/fb7524188cfb489a2f2c3820283d1aaeb016c0fa.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45075098/19b37b0120c15d5bff1ab85b137728cbb7205f9e.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45075098/70065f118a302b15de6fb233fc1e112b8e5e788e.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45075098/87e33c2c2abab69a149f4d4f9c73a60813348e8d.jpg[/img]
[h3]Stay tuned and don’t miss the updated demo — it’s going to be epic![/h3]
